messages:
dani: Thinking out loud — can we add an 'Explain' toggle on the cost dashboard that expands per-invocation attribution (token cost, cache-savings, model-variant split)? want this to help SREs and PMs debug sudden unit-cost jumps :eyes:
sam: Love the idea. main perf worry is the telemetry volume if we keep raw per-invocation traces enabled. how do you imagine sampling / retention?
chao: Proposal: keep the default as aggregated rollups, and enable per-invocation explainability only when a user toggles a time window + sample rate (e.g. 0.1% / 1k invs). store sampled traces in a hot store for 7d, then blob to cold storage.
liv: UX note — make the toggle contextual: "Explain (sampled)" with a tooltip explaining sampling bias and confidence interval. show sparkline of sampled vs estimated total. hover to see explanation of each line item (batching, kv-cache hit, model-size). :sparkles:
ajay: From API side we'd add a query param to the internal econ endpoint, e.g.:
```
GET /internal/econ/route/{route_id}/decompose?window=1h&sample_rate=0.001&explain=true
```
response would include an array of sampled_invocation_ids + reasoned breakdown per sample. we need to cap response size.
sam: SQL/infra question — do we have a schema for sampled_invocations? we could piggyback on the existing telemetry id but we need to join with cache/hotpath annotations. any perf-safe join pattern?
chao: rough SQL sketch (for discussion):
```sql
WITH sampled AS (SELECT inv_id FROM invs WHERE timestamp > now()-interval '1h' AND random() < 0.001)
SELECT s.inv_id, i.route, i.model_sku, i.tokens, c.cache_hit, cost_model.unit_cost
FROM sampled s JOIN invs i USING (inv_id) LEFT JOIN cache_events c USING (inv_id) LEFT JOIN cost_model USING (model_sku)
LIMIT 1000;
```
we'll push heavy work into offline pre-agg tasks and only run small joins in the API layer.
dani: Good, that aligns with the product ask — PMs want per-model ROI samples and a way to export the sampled CSV for auditing. also need to surface the estimator we use so they trust the extrapolation.
liv: UX: Add a small "explainability confidence" pill next to totals, with link to how sample->estimate is computed. And an "export samples" button that includes telemetry context + route config.
ajay: I'll prototype the API with paging + max samples (e.g. max=2000). also add a header X-Explain-Sampled: true on the response so frontend can show sampling disclosures.
opsbot: Database migration queue created: add table econ_sampled_invs (inv_id text, route text, model_sku text, cached boolean, tokens int, sampled_at timestamptz) — migration id mig-2026-04-03-09.
sam: Quick checklist: 1) quota implications (sampling requests are high-cost) 2) privacy — ensure PII scrubbed before export 3) rate-limits on explain endpoint 4) telemetry retention policy doc update.
dani: I'll update the console spec PR with sampling defaults, export CSV schema, and the estimate algorithm paragraph. tagging @ajay to coordinate API surface. :thumbsup: 
ajay: ack, will start a branch and ping for review when the API proto exists.
chao: One more thought — we should show both sampled raw and the extrapolated line in the same chart so people can see variance. also add a small note about bias when sampling correlated bursts.
liv: sounds good. I'll draft the mockup for the toggle + pill and attach in the PR.
opsbot: deploy-bot: migration mig-2026-04-03-09 queued on staging cluster 'redwood-stg-1'.
dani: Great, thanks everyone. next step: ajay branch + liv mockup + dani spec update. will check back in after initial prototype.
